metadata.description: Version 1 of one line of vibe app watch --json and of the home's events journal applications/events.jsonl (PROP-059#launcher-runtime): what changed, the catalog revision after the change, the key the change is about when there is one (a package key for installed, updated and removed, a launcher key for started and exited and for an override of one launcher), the process id of a started or exited launcher, and the RFC 3339 time.
An exact non-negative count. JTD has no uint64 form, so generated Rust narrows the numeric form to u64.
